<thought>Using the molecular formula C12H14Cl (ignoring the O0), the double bond equivalents are calculated as DBE = (2C + 2 - H - X)/2 = (2*12 + 2 - 14 - 1)/2 = (24 + 2 - 15)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the correct integer value is 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
